messages:
maria: posted this and immediately surrendered my laundry duties — Luna has declared the basket her throne. pic: https://i.imgur.com/Abc1234.jpg :joy:
jad: omg the face. that's a burrito and i'm not okay. more pics pls :pleading_face:
alex: 10/10 will adopt in my heart. Luna is obviously the boss.
emily: the tiny tucked paws!!! also how is she not sinking into a puddle of fluff? :rofl:
maria: professional bun-level folding. she also rearranged my socks into a perimeter for safety. bonus pic: https://i.imgur.com/Def5678.jpg
chris: petition to make Luna the official office mascot. vote :thumbsup: for yes, :thumbsdown: for treason
ops-bot: noted reaction recorded :thumbsup: (not an official vote)
jad: @maria will Luna be allowed to attend the next in-person puppy day? i'm volunteering to bring the treats :dog2:
maria: trying to coordinate with people next Friday — if it works out i'll post a calendar invite titled "Luna's Nap Hour"
alex: if there's a calendar invite it must have a Zoom link for remote pets. remote cam of Luna required.
emily: new PR rule: include a dog pic in the description -> auto-approve. This is non-negotiable.
chris: bribe plan: I will offer Luna gourmet training treats if she sits on my keyboard during standup. Will update.
maria: quick audio: tiny snore when disturbed, will upload later (she grumbled and then resumed burritoing)
jad: made a terrible but accurate meme: "Folded clothes: 0, Luna's bed: 1"
maria: here's one final one where she hides my phone under the socks when i'm late for calls. Luna 3, punctuality 0 :sweat_smile:
